tagline: A from-scratch Three.js engine graded against PS4-native reference frames. Builders ship, critics score blind, the gap comes back. Repeat until the tier is indistinguishable.

systems.name: Scene Foundation
systems.brief: Sky, atmosphere, terrain, lighting, shadows, grade. The dependency root — every other system renders on top of this.
systems.next: Two builders running in parallel: Atmosphere (sky, light, shadows, post) and Terrain (heightfield, LOD, materials, scatter). Integrate, capture all five shots, then hand to two blind critics.

systems.name: Character System
systems.brief: Original humanoid mesh, skeleton, skinning, PBR materials, idle animation. No copyrighted likeness or ripped rig.
systems.next: Blocked on Scene Foundation passing — character materials must be graded under final lighting, not stub lighting.

systems.name: Environment Zone
systems.brief: One complete playable zone: props, NPCs, interactables, foliage density, set dressing that reads as authored rather than scattered.
systems.next: Queued behind Scene Foundation and Character.

systems.name: Visual Polish
systems.brief: Particles, volumetrics, foliage translucency, material layering, atmospheric depth — the pass that closes the last gap to the reference tier.
systems.next: Runs continuously once a system passes its first gate.

systems.name: Player Interaction
systems.brief: Character controller, collision against the heightfield, camera rig, interaction prompts, HUD overlay.
systems.next: Queued. Depends on terrain heightAt() and the character rig.
